deadline.value: For Fall admission, international applicants should apply by February 1; these are soft deadlines.
deadline.quote: Feb. 1 for international applicants, July 15 for U.S. students

gre_general.value: The program does not require GRE scores for admission or aid.
gre_general.quote: we do not require submission of GRE scores in applications. | They are not required for admissions and financial aid.

fee_waiver.value: Applicants with good English scores and bachelor's grades are entitled to an application fee waiver, with no hardship claim needed.
fee_waiver.quote: Applicants with good English scores and BS grades are entitled to a waiver of the application fee.

also.quote: Any applicant with a reasonable chance to be admitted will get it.

gre_subject.value: The page does not state a subject GRE rule.

supervisor.value: The page does not state a supervisor rule before admission.

funding.value: Admission and financial support are competitive.
funding.quote: Admission and support such as tuition scholarships, research and teaching assistantships are competitive.

entry_route.value: Applicants can enter with a master's or go straight from a bachelor's, which takes 4 to 6 years.
entry_route.quote: Full-time students who enter the program without a master’s degree typically require 4-6 years to complete the program

notes: Deadlines are soft to allow time for the F-1 visa application.
